correctness.rationale: Oller-Marcén's Proposition 6 specializes to \(\ell\mid P-1\) and \(m\mid Q-1\) or \(\operatorname{ord}_m(P)=\ell\). If \(\ell\mid m-1\), the cyclic group modulo \(m\) has exactly \(\ell-1\) classes of order \(\ell\); CRT with \(P\equiv1\pmod\ell\) gives \(\ell-1\) reduced classes modulo \(\ell m\). Fixed-modulus PNT in arithmetic progressions then yields density \(1/(m-1)\) for the cross-supplying P's and the displayed pair constants. The finite checker matches the structural criterion on its bounded test set.
